description: This file defines a static internal class 'SubscriptionMarker' that provides methods to mark and identify subscription GUIDs as implicit or explicit by manipulating the high bit of the GUID's last byte.

classes.name: SubscriptionMarker
classes.description: A static class providing methods to mark GUIDs as implicit or explicit subscriptions and to check their type.

methods.name: MarkAsExplicitSubscriptionId
methods.description: Marks a GUID as an explicit subscription ID by clearing the high bit of its last byte.

methods.name: MarkAsImplictSubscriptionId
methods.description: Marks a GUID as an implicit subscription ID by setting the high bit of its last byte.

methods.name: IsImplicitSubscription
methods.description: Checks if a GUID is marked as an implicit subscription by examining the high bit of its last byte.

methods.name: MarkSubscriptionGuid
methods.description: Helper method that sets or clears the high bit of a GUID's last byte based on the isImplicitSubscription flag.
